design.title: Frozen test subset: supplied-context intervention

index.signature: Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B|1d8ad4ca9b3dd8059ad90a75d4983776a23d44af|last_token|8192|True|Given a question on adult blood pressure measurement, screening or diagnosis, retrieve applicable clinical guideline recommendations and systematic-review evidence, matching the population, named authority, setting and measurement method.

design.selection_rule: Eight answerable test questions selected before reading their system outputs; spread across classification, source comparison, confirmation, measurement, screening, review evidence, and exceptions; includes single- and multi-evidence cases.

conditions.empty_supplied: No evidence IDs are preloaded; the same default adaptive router may retrieve its normal evidence.
conditions.gold_supplied: All joint gold IDs are preloaded; the same default adaptive router may reuse them or follow its ordinary evidence-gap behavior.
conditions.neighbor_only: A count-matched set of same-theme records from different non-gold sources is preloaded, with no gold IDs; the same default adaptive router may reuse, supplement or abstain.

selected_questions.query: AHA/ACC与ISH 2026分别把130–139/80–89 mmHg归为什么类别？
selected_questions.distractor_reason: NICE第1期联合诊室/诊室外分级和USPSTF机构阈值范围都涉及130–140段，但不是AHA/ACC与ISH类别比较的共同金标。

selected_questions.query: NICE对诊室150/96 mmHg的成人如何复测，并用什么方式确认？
selected_questions.distractor_reason: AHA/ACC与ISH也谈诊室外确认，但不是NICE规定的同次复测与ABPM区间金标。

selected_questions.query: 给医生一个AHA/ACC 140/90 mmHg诊室值对应的夜间和24小时ABPM表值。
selected_questions.distractor_reason: ISH的诊室外确认建议主题相近，但不是AHA/ACC表7的140/90测量映射值。

selected_questions.query: 按ISH 2026的分级，成人标准化诊室160/100 mmHg处于哪个等级？
selected_questions.distractor_reason: AHA/ACC也以140/90作为第2期阈值，但标签与ISH的Grade 2问题不能跨机构替代。

selected_questions.query: 按ISH标准化诊室方案，安静坐位准备多久，袖带臂应怎样放置？
selected_questions.distractor_reason: NICE与USPSTF都有安静坐位、上臂测量等相邻规则，但不是ISH的休息时长与手臂高度依据。

selected_questions.query: USPSTF的筛查建议适用于哪类成人，何时须进行诊室外确认？
selected_questions.distractor_reason: NICE成人范围和AHA/ACC诊室外确认与筛查主题相近，但不能替代USPSTF对象及其确认前置条件。

selected_questions.query: USPSTF综述比较诊室初筛与诊室确诊时，二者的敏感度和特异度各是多少？
selected_questions.distractor_reason: JAHA有人/无人测量差值及AHA/ACC确诊建议涉及血压测量，但不提供USPSTF综述的初筛与诊室确诊准确性。

selected_questions.query: NICE诊室读数180/120且合并新发意识混乱，应如何分流？
selected_questions.distractor_reason: ISH的单次就诊诊断例外也涉及严重血压和靶器官损害，但不替代NICE的当日转诊红旗条件。

runtime.elapsed_note: Sequential requests; all three conditions use the same default adaptive system. Main-experiment adaptive rows are a separate post-hoc comparator.
